summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of iteration 3 (multi-currency, per-kg flat shipping, duty toggle, Suppliers/Products masters, config accordion + import/export). Verified all 5 tabs (desktop + mobile nav), calculator engine math for INR/CNY/ZAR, price basis toggle, all 3 shipping methods, duty on/off, quantity units (roll/meter), validation (empty/zero/negative), save->dashboard->reload persistence, history search, reuse, PDF quote popup, copy code, Suppliers/Products add/edit/delete/Use prefill, in-calculator load-supplier/load-product quick loads, config rate/currency/duty/subcategory edits with live recompute + persistence, config export download, and the iteration-2 import regression. Core app is stable - no crashes, no white-screen, all buttons clickable. 2 substantive findings (expected-value mismatch vs default lace rule; shallow-merge data loss on partial config import) plus 2 minor issues.

ui_bugs.issue: navigator.clipboard.writeText() rejection is unhandled -> CRA dev overlay 'Uncaught runtime errors: NotAllowedError: Failed to execute writeText' appears, and the success toast 'Supplier code copied' is shown even when the copy failed. Wrap in promise .then/.catch and only toast on success.
React warning: 'Select is changing from uncontrolled to controlled' (value={form.x || undefined}). Cosmetic console noise only.

integration_issues.issue: Regression from iteration 2 is FIXED - importing {categories:[...], shippingRates:{india-sa:{...}}} imports cleanly with no white-screen and garbage JSON is rejected with 'Invalid configuration file' toast. HOWEVER the merge is shallow (spread over DEFAULT_CONFIG), so nested maps are replaced wholesale: after importing a file containing only india-sa shipping rates, china-sa rates were lost and a China-route calculation silently used 'Shipping (5 kg @ R 0,00/kg)' = R 0,00 with no warning. Same risk for a partial currencyRates object. Recommend a per-route/per-method deep merge in Configuration.importConfig and storage.normaliseConfig.

issues: 3-column rate table overflows its card; the third column (Ship) is off-screen until horizontally scrolled and there is no visible scroll affordance. Inputs are still reachable/editable after scroll, so low priority.

action_items: Reconcile the reference expectations: request stated Lace+India+Ship / INR 100 per-meter / 9 m / 5 kg / qty 3 => R 56,20 per meter, R 505,77 per roll, R 1 517,31 order total, duty-off R 473,17. Actual UI shows R 56,92 / R 512,29 / R 1 536,87 and duty-off R 479,69 because the seeded default custom rule 'Fragile Lace surcharge' (+3% of product cost = R 5,67) is correctly applied for category=lace. Engine math is internally consistent and every other component matches (product R 189,00 = 100x0.21x9; shipping R 63,00 = 60x0.21x5; duty R 28,35; handling R 159,45; VAT 15%). Either the expected values are stale or the default lace rule should not ship enabled - main agent to confirm.
Deep-merge nested config objects (shippingRates, currencyRates, per-route method maps) on import/normalise so a partial import cannot silently zero out a route's shipping rate.
Handle clipboard write rejection in CalculatorPage.copyCode and only show the success toast on resolve.
Optional: give the mobile shipping-rate table a scroll hint or stack the 3 methods vertically under 480px.
critical_code_review_comments: storage.normaliseConfig and Configuration.importConfig both use `{...DEFAULT_CONFIG, ...raw}` (shallow). Any stored/imported config missing a nested key (e.g. shippingRates['china-sa']) yields rate 0 at calculation time via `num(...) || 0` with no user-visible warning - prefer explicit deep merge + validation.

calculator.js computes shipping rate as `num(config.shippingRates?.[routeId]?.[method]) || 0`; a missing rate should surface a validation error/warning in the UI instead of quietly producing R 0,00 shipping.
qtyUnit 'pcs' falls through to the per-roll branch in orderTotal (`qtyUnit === 'meter' ? perMeter : perRoll`). Verify that pieces priced as whole rolls is intended.
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted TEST supplier 'TEST Delhi Trims' and TEST product 'TEST Denim Roll'; saved TEST calculations to history. Browser automation runs use a fresh profile each time so localStorage test data does not persist between runs. Config was reset to defaults at the end of each config test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 tabs, calculator engine (INR/CNY/ZAR conversion, per_meter/per_roll basis, Air Safe 800/Air+ 650/Ship 60 INR per kg, duty on/off, qty unit roll/meter order total), validation, save/reuse/export/search on dashboard, PDF popup, suppliers & products CRUD + Use prefill, in-calculator quick loads, config accordion edits + persistence + export download + import (garbage rejected, partial accepted) were all verified working on iteration 3. Note: new suppliers/products are PREPENDED to the list, so use-supplier-0 / product-card-0 is the most recently added item. section-shipping is open by default - clicking section-shipping COLLAPSES it (rate-* inputs then disappear). Remaining gaps intentionally not retested: full custom-rule CRUD in section-rules, cost-tier add/remove, category add/remove.
rca_of_the_issue: Expected-value mismatch RCA: DEFAULT_CONFIG.customRules seeds 'rule-fragile-lace' (+3% of product cost, category=lace, route=any) which applyCustomRules correctly applies to every Lace calculation, adding R 5,67 to the subtotal and R 6,52 to the total after VAT - exactly the delta between the requested reference figures and the live UI. Partial-import RCA: importConfig does `setConfig({...structuredClone(DEFAULT_CONFIG), ...data})`; because the spread is shallow, `data.shippingRates` (containing only india-sa) replaces the entire default map, so `config.shippingRates['china-sa']` becomes undefined and calculator.js falls back to 0.
